backend.name: gpu
backend.note: GPU available: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060, 610.88, 12288 MiB.

azimuth_convention: orientation_rad[0]: yaw counter-clockwise from east (scene x east, y north); sector_bearings_deg: compass, clockwise from north

antenna_rule.site_selection: interference-aware SINR greedy over physical sites (scripts/plan_sites.py)
antenna_rule.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner (2026-11-26, 2026-11-27; configs/approvals.yaml)

tx_power_dbm.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
tx_power_dbm.justification: 46 dBm is the macro downlink power in the 3GPP 6G coverage assumptions (TR 38.914 Table 5.1.20.1-2), the E-UTRA reference base station (TR 36.942 Table 4.6), ITU-R M.2292 macro urban (Tables 3-4) and TR 38.921 (two polarisations, 7 GHz range). The same total power in every band; the power per MHz therefore falls with bandwidth (33 dBm/MHz at 20 MHz, 26 at 100 MHz, 20 at 400 MHz).

tx_antenna_gain_dbi.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
tx_antenna_gain_dbi.justification: Zero because the traced tr38901 pattern already contains the 8 dBi peak gain; any other value would count the gain twice (refused when the file is loaded).

tx_antenna_pattern.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
tx_antenna_pattern.justification: 3GPP TR 38.901 Table 7.3-1 sector element (65 degree beamwidth, 8 dBi peak, 30 dB front-to-back), the element ITU-R M.2412 also uses. It is TRACED by the ray tracer, so its gain is part of the path gain.

sectors_per_site.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
sectors_per_site.justification: Three sectors per site (M.2412 section 8.3: three TRxPs per site).

mechanical_downtilt_deg.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
mechanical_downtilt_deg.justification: Macro urban downtilt of 10 degrees (M.2292 Tables 3-4; TR 38.921 Table 8.1.2-1).

antenna_height_above_roof_m.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
antenna_height_above_roof_m.justification: Decision A4. No primary source gives a mast height above a roof; the references give total heights (25 m in M.2412 and TR 38.901 UMa) for flat layouts. Antennas stand at the roof edge facing each sector (configs/site_rule.yaml).

rx_height_m.approved_by: project description, Stage 6 (the approved project baseline)
rx_height_m.justification: Receivers 1.5 m above street level; the outdoor UE height of M.2412 Table 5(b).

rx_antenna_gain_dbi.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
rx_antenna_gain_dbi.justification: Isotropic user antenna, matching the isotropic receiver of the ray-traced maps (0 dBi in TR 36.942 section 4.2.2, M.2412 at 4 GHz, TR 38.830 for FR1). M.2412 and TR 38.830 give 5 dBi at 30 GHz with user-side beamforming, left to the deployment interpretation.

noise_figure_db.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
noise_figure_db.justification: 9 dB user noise figure in the 3GPP 6G coverage assumptions (TR 38.914 Table 5.1.20.1-2), TR 36.942 Table 4.8, M.2292 Table 1 and the TR 38.921 baseline. Per-band values (7 dB at 4 GHz, 10 dB at 30 GHz in M.2412) belong to the deployment interpretation.

noise_temperature_k.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
noise_temperature_k.justification: Reference temperature T0 = 290 K (P.372 section 1.2.1), giving -174 dBm/Hz (M.2412 Table 5).

coverage_threshold.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
coverage_threshold.justification: -10 dB is the lowest SINR at which the 3GPP link-level throughput mapping gives any data rate (TR 38.921 Table 4.2.7-1, TR 36.942 Annex A). A noise-referenced threshold is the same physical condition at every bandwidth.

interference_activity.unit: share of time other sectors transmit
interference_activity.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
interference_activity.justification: Full buffer (M.2412 Table 5): every other sector transmits all the time. M.2292 uses a 50 % average activity, a sensitivity case.

coverage_target.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
coverage_target.justification: 95 % cell-area reliability for control channels (TR 38.830 Table A.3).

frequency_reuse.approved_by: supervisor, as reported by the project owner on 2026-11-26 (configs/approvals.yaml)
frequency_reuse.justification: Every site and sector uses the whole carrier (M.2412 evaluations; M.2292 Tables 2-4).

scenarios.label: 4G LTE
scenarios.basis: LTE Band 3. All three Iraqi operators launched LTE on 1800 MHz in January 2021. 20 MHz is the largest Band 3 channel and a modelling assumption: no source gives the carrier width used in Iraq. 1.8 GHz is nominal; the Band 3 downlink is 1805-1880 MHz.

scenarios.label: 5G NR mid-band
scenarios.basis: NR band n78 (3300-3800 MHz, up to 100 MHz). The Iraqi regulator's plan names 3.4-3.8 GHz as the main 5G capacity band with 100 MHz blocks per licence holder, but no 5G spectrum had been assigned and no commercial 5G launched as of November 2026.

scenarios.label: Candidate 6G upper mid-band
scenarios.basis: WRC-27 agenda item 1.7: in ITU Region 1 (which includes Iraq) 7.125-7.25 GHz and 7.75-8.4 GHz are under study for mobile use; the carrier occupies 7.8-8.2 GHz. 400 MHz is the maximum carrier bandwidth 3GPP agreed for the 7 GHz range in March 2026. Not identified for mobile use yet.

scenarios.label: Candidate 6G 15 GHz
scenarios.basis: WRC-27 agenda item 1.7: 14.8-15.35 GHz is under study in all regions; the carrier occupies 14.8-15.2 GHz. 400 MHz is the bandwidth 3GPP assumes at 15 GHz for 6G evaluation; no carrier maximum has been agreed for this range. Used today in Iraq for fixed links and defence systems. Not identified for mobile use yet.

scenarios.label: 5G NR mmWave
scenarios.basis: High-capacity 5G reference: NR bands n257 and n261, largest channel 400 MHz. No plan for this band in Iraq was found.
